eps.ov: Five boys newly enrolled in a formerly all-girls school, already having difficulty connecting with the girl students, run afoul of the school’s "Underground Student Council" and face strict disciplinary measures.
eps.oa: خمسة فتيان التحقوا حديثاً بمدرسة كانت للبنات وحدهن، يجدون صعوبة أصلاً في التواصل مع الطالبات، فيصطدمون بـ«مجلس الطلبة السري» ويواجهون إجراءات تأديبية صارمة.

eps.t: The Man Who Viewed Too Much
eps.ov: Hana is embarrassed when Kiyoshi sees her in a compromising position. Kiyoshi becomes desperate to keep his date with Chiyo, and searches for a way to get out of prison in time to meet her. Gakuto has plans of his own.
eps.ta: الرجل الذي رأى أكثر مما ينبغي
eps.oa: تخجل «هانا» حين يراها «كيوشي» في موقف محرج. ويستميت كيوشي في الحفاظ على موعده مع «تشييو»، فيبحث عن طريقة يخرج بها من السجن في الوقت المناسب للقائها. ولـ«غاكوتو» خططه الخاصة.

eps.ov: With Meiko’s attention divided between two groups, Kiyoshi is able to widen the escape hole enough to let him through in time for his date. An already-suspicious Shingo gets an eyeful of more than he bargained for.
eps.oa: مع انقسام انتباه «ميكو» بين جماعتين، يتمكن «كيوشي» من توسيع فتحة الهروب بما يكفي ليعبر منها في الوقت المناسب لموعده. ويرى «شينغو»، المرتاب أصلاً، أكثر مما توقع.

eps.t: Take Me Out to the Sumoland
eps.ov: After committing a heinous offense against Mari, Gakuto receives a drastic punishment from Meiko. Kiyoshi and Gakuto work desperately to break Kiyoshi out of the prison by having him impersonate a girl.
eps.oa: بعد أن يرتكب «غاكوتو» إساءة شنيعة في حق «ماري» تعاقبه «ميكو» عقاباً قاسياً. ويعمل «كيوشي» وغاكوتو بيأس على تهريب كيوشي من السجن بأن يتنكر في هيئة فتاة.

eps.t: The School’s Number One Most Treacherous Man
eps.ov: Kiyoshi returns from his breakout, but must face the music with Gakuto and the others when the truth comes to light. Chiyo reconsiders her reaction to Kiyoshi, and decides to give him a second chance.
eps.oa: يعود «كيوشي» من هروبه، لكن عليه أن يواجه العاقبة مع «غاكوتو» والآخرين حين تنكشف الحقيقة. وتعيد «تشييو» النظر في موقفها من كيوشي، فتقرر أن تمنحه فرصة ثانية.

eps.ov: Mari introduces the DTO plan to Hana, and they begin plotting ways to drive the boys out of school. Shingo leads the others boys in shunning Kiyoshi, but Meiko has plans to drive an even deeper wedge between them.
eps.oa: تعرض «ماري» خطة DTO على «هانا»، فتبدآن تدبير طرق لطرد الفتيان من المدرسة. ويقود «شينغو» بقية الفتيان في مقاطعة «كيوشي»، لكن عند «ميكو» خططاً لتعميق الشقاق بينهم أكثر.

eps.ov: Shingo, on furlough from the prison, meets a girl named Anzu at the arcade in town. When Gakuto turns to his Guan Yu figurine for guidance, the tip of his sword falls off, starting a chain of events with momentous consequences.

Andre suffers a mental collapse when he goes for a week without receiving any discipline. Shingo takes Anzu to the movies, but finds his expectations betrayed. The Underground Student Council moves forward with their DTO project.

Shingo realizes that he saw emails regarding DTO on the computer in the corrections office, which if recovered by the boys, would prove that they were set up. The boys plot to break into the corrections office.

The boys are resigned to their upcoming expulsions, and spirits are low, until Gakuto, suffering a bout of temporary insanity, devises one last strategy to get them out of their predicament, if they can just buy enough time to pull it off.

Given a one-day reprieve, the boys must again execute a plan to get inside the corrections office, but the Underground Student Council won’t make it easy for them. Hana has a personal score that she wishes to settle with Kiyoshi.

Hana continues pressing Kiyoshi in order to exact her revenge, but Kiyoshi employs an adaptation of a classical military strategy to counter her. Once all the boys are locked into their cells for the night, will they be able to complete their plan?
